description: This file defines the 'AdminUserCreationController' class, which extends an abstract installer Vue controller to handle the admin user creation process within the installer module of the OrangeHRM system. It mainly implements a preRender method that sets up the frontend component and updates the application state.

classes.name: AdminUserCreationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the admin user creation step in the installer process. Sets up the front-end component and manages application state during pre-render phase.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the admin user creation screen component and updates the current screen state.
